propositions: Hardcoded src/rebar file scan and .github/module-size-limit.txt file reference must be removed from git_metrics and registry, replacing them with [code_health] config-driven adapter
module_size_distribution and oversized_module_count functions must accept uniform 3-arg signature (loc, size_cap, size_near_fraction) and compute counts based on LOC payload from scc_loc.analyze()
size_cap=None must yield None for near_cap_count and over_cap_count, and oversized_module_count must return None (rendering as Unavailable) rather than fabricated zeros
near-cap boundary must use inclusive bounds: size_cap*(1-size_near_fraction) <= loc <= size_cap, excluding files over size_cap
analyzer-derived MetricSpec entries must carry source='structural', lens='code_health', and accruing_since timestamp; the oversized_module_count seed stub must be removed leaving only one spec per id
unconfigured or failed scc_loc.analyze (Unavailable) must propagate to Unavailable metric output, never leak errno or return {count:0,max_loc:0}
